description: This PHP class defines a console command for managing and executing scheduled cron jobs within the Goteo application. It includes methods for adding jobs, reading configuration from YAML, and executing scheduled tasks, integrating with external libraries like Cron, Symfony Console, and YAML.

classes.name: CronCommand
classes.description: A console command class for managing cron jobs, including adding, listing, and executing scheduled tasks, with configuration loaded from YAML files.

methods.name: setResolver
methods.description: Sets the resolver for cron jobs.

methods.name: getResolver
methods.description: Retrieves the current resolver, initializing with ArrayResolver if null.

methods.name: addJob
methods.description: Adds a cron job to the resolver.

methods.name: addSchedule
methods.description: Creates and adds a scheduled shell command job.

methods.name: addCrontabLine
methods.description: Adds a crontab line with command and schedule, handling PHP and nice options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that loads predefined tasks from a YAML configuration file based on environment.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the console command, including name, description, options, and help text.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the cron command, listing crontab, jobs, or running scheduled tasks and reporting results.
